items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Was it with, you want to know if you did that with King Holland?

ctx.x: No, I don't think he's on that- Mm-hm. Did you- No. Mm-hm. That- That King-Oliver's Big Band- Yeah. We're talking about the ones with Johnny Darius on clarinet and no sax- His first records- earliest records-
Was it with, you want to know if you did that with King Holland?
No, I said did you ever hear any of the records that they made down here, when you were down here?
